issue: STATUS CHANGE for T1: GEM has Status='shelved' (Substatus='confirmed', ShelvedYear/StopYear=2021, last_updated 2025-07-01 - i.e. pre-restart). The Mozambique LNG consortium LIFTED the 2021 force majeure on 7 November 2025 and TotalEnergies + President Chapo announced the FULL RESTART of all onshore and offshore activities on 29 January 2026. Construction has resumed at the Afungi site (>4,000 workers mobilised), the project is reported ~40% complete, and first LNG is targeted for 2029. The sanctioned two-train plant (T1/T2) is therefore effectively 'construction' again, NOT 'shelved'. Per brief, a Status change is flagged here and NOT staged as a Status field edit (fetch_timeline endpoint is down). Sources: totalenergies.com restart PR (29 Jan 2026), Al Jazeera, Enerdata, JPT (force-majeure lift).
suggested_action: Change Status shelved->construction and Substatus confirmed->construction for T1/T2; add a timeline event (force majeure lifted 2025-11-07; full restart 2026-01-29) when fetch_timeline is reachable. Re-set ShelvedYear/StopYear handling (the 2021 shelving is now a closed historical interval, not the current status). First LNG 2029.

issue: T3 models the PROPOSED Train 3 / Train 4 expansion (announced Nov 2019), which never reached FID and was not part of the sanctioned/financed two-train project. GEM holds it 'shelved' (ShelvedYear/StopYear=2021). With the base project (T1/T2) restarting in 2025/26, the expansion's status is ambiguous: it was never under construction, so 'proposed' (or 'shelved' pending an expansion decision) may be more accurate than tying it to the 2021 base-project force majeure. No current source confirms an active T3/T4 expansion decision. Not staged.
suggested_action: Decide whether T3/T4 should be 'proposed' (never-FID'd expansion) vs 'shelved'; the 2021 force-majeure framing fits the base plant, not the unsanctioned expansion. Watch for an expansion FID announcement post-restart.

issue: T3 Capacity=5.00 mtpa could NOT be corroborated off-GEM. The T3/T4 expansion (Train 3 & 4) was announced as a study in Nov 2019 but never reached FID, and no published source states a discrete ~5.0 mtpa-per-train figure for it (sources give the BASE plant as 12.88-13.1 mtpa total and the long-run expansion ceiling as 'up to 43 mtpa', not a 5.0/train breakdown). Additionally, the GEM-cited Capacity [ref] for T3/T4 (reuters.com/...anadarko-jera...idUSL8N0Z92O120150625) is a 2015 JERA-offtake article that PRE-DATES the 2019 T3/T4 proposal and does not support a 5.0 mtpa figure - a mismatched citation. Capacity staged yellow (single weak basis via clubofmozambique for the existence of the trains, not the number).
suggested_action: Treat T3/T4 Capacity=5.0 mtpa as a GEM planning estimate; relocate or blank if no per-train expansion capacity is published. Replace the mismatched 2015 Reuters ref. The expansion remains pre-FID.
